text: Have mercy on me, God, according to your steadfast love; because of your great compassion, wipe out my rebellious acts.
Wash me completely clean of my guilt, and purify me from my sin.
For I am well aware of my rebellious acts, and my sin is constantly in front of me.
Against you, you alone, I have sinned and done what is evil in your sight, so that you are right when you speak and justified when you judge.
Truly, I was born guilty; I was sinful from the moment my mother conceived me.
Yet you desire truth in my inmost being; teach me wisdom in that hidden place.
Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.
Turn your face away from my sins, and blot out all my guilt.
Create in me a pure heart, God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
Do not banish me from your presence, and do not take your Holy Spirit away from me.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and give me a willing spirit to sustain me.
Then I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will return to you.
Deliver me from bloodguilt, God, God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.
Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.
You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; you take no pleasure in burnt offerings.
The sacrifices God wants are a broken spirit; God, you will not despise a broken and humbled heart.
In your good pleasure, make Zion prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
Then you will delight in proper sacrifices, whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on your altar.
